import re
ttl = open(GRAPH_TTL).read()
# get each Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor block
pat = re.compile(r'bldg:(Zone_F\d_Z\d\d\.Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor) a brick:Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor \;\s*(.*?)(?=\.|\S)', re.S)
results = {}
for m in re.finditer(r'bldg:(Zone_F\d_Z\d\d\.Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor) a brick:Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor', ttl):
    name = m.group(1)
    block = ttl[m.start():m.start()+600]
    zone = re.search(r'brick:isPointOf (bldg:\S+)', block)
    ext = re.search(r'hasExternalReference <urn:buildgraph:tsref:(\S+)>', block)
    print(name, zone.group(1) if zone else None, ext.group(1)[:8] if ext else None)
    results[name]= (zone.group(1) if zone else None, ext.group(1) if ext else None)
import json
print(json.dumps(results, indent=1)[:2000])
